reviews.comment: Instead of using teacher platforms that prevent attendance discrepancies he shames the whole class for cheating and punishes everyone by taking away attendance grades and extra credit for those who did show up to class.  It's disheartening to have such an important class be taught by someone who seems to go out of his way to make students hate him.

This class just takes a lot of time. Is it hard? Yes, but as long as you have friends/meet people in the class and do the homework together, it makes it a lot easier. Also, GO TO OFFICE HOURS. The TAs will help you with the homework and check it. Mjelde is super sarcastic but cares for his students.

Professor Mjelde is a major disappointment. He leaves nearly all instruction to his TAs. His lectures are disorganized, and it's clear he's disengaged from the course. His homework is a joke and took hours to complete. He is arrogant and dodges student questions, passing them off to TAs. Avoid him if you want an actual professor who teaches!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 317 is a hard class and it's probably going to suck and take a lot of work. Mjelde and the TAs all care although you may not think so at first. Best advice ask the TA's and Mjelde for help, take it with a friend, & go to an extra lab. If you put in the work and stay on top of it you will get through it, not every college class can be easy.

This class is hard. If you are here, it's because you have to be. Mjelde is sarcastic and lazy. He is not all that rude; he's sarcastic. You have to apply yourself and use critical thinking, but this is college, and you should be doing that anyway. The TAs will save your life. Make a friend in the class, show up to everything, and you'll be fine.

The professor doesn't teach anything or explain why the material is useful in any way
The canvas is completely unorganized and a total mess 
He is rude and will blanket accuse half the class of cheating at some point in your semester
The homeworks will take HOURS because he doesn't explain how to do anything on them
Worst class I have ever taken.

I have never had a teacher who actually wanted students to fail, until Mjelde. It's actually unbelievable. Homework, lectures, labs are not connected at all. Excruciatingly boring lectures. Canvas is incredibly unorganized and there's pretty much an assignment due every other day throughout the semester. You better pray for good TAs. Fire him

This is easily the worst professor I have ever had. There are plenty of reviews explaining how awful he is so here's my advice. If possible, take over summer with another prof. If you can't then don't wait last minute to do the HWs. HW will take 5+ hrs or more. Meet TAs to go over HW long before due. Never miss lecture or lab.

I have never made a rate my professor review until right now. The AGEC department has fundamentally failed in following student feedback by continuing to have Mjelde teach this class. He is terribly unorganized and prone to making mistakes that will affect your grade. He also enjoys seeing you fail. There is nothing you can do to avoid it either.

1. The TAs are the only way you can be successful in class. Send them your homework to review. Labs have vague instructions. 
2. Mjelde is incredibly antagonistic to students. He called a girl a "ditzy blonde" to her face, as example. 

My advice? Study the theory. Take the class over the summer if you can. The department knows Mjelde has issues.

My first rating to a professor at TAMU as a senior and I just want to say that this course is antagonistic. More homework than all of my other classes combined, my grades in other classes suffer because I spend so much time doing work for this class, and to top it off, the class is horribly organized. Take over the summer at all costs.

Mjelde is passionate about making this class as hard as possible and does not care if you succeed. After our first exam, he announced to the class that the exam average was a 30 and laughed as if he was pleased. Asking him questions is useless, he will only make you feel dumb with a snarky comment and act like you should already know the answer.

This teacher is one of the worst things to come out of A&M; the school should be ashamed. He is disrespectful to us. The homework assignments are difficult and omit steps that we're somehow expected to read their minds. The TAs are disparaging, and I am appalled that any of them were hired.  The AGEC department will be hearing from me.

Professor was was extremely rude to everyone in class including his own TA's (who were basically running the entire class for him). If it was not required to take him in this class then nobody would cause this class was awful as during lab he will not help you if you were having difficulty and lectures are very difficult to understand.

This professor was terrible. No respect, never helpful. When you needed help he would pretty much tell you off if you did not know what you were talking about. Pray for excellent TAs because without them, I would not have passed. Very strict about academic integrity and threatened to get you kicked out of TAMU for cheating on an attendance quiz...

This class is not as bad as it used to be. As of 2024 he has made tweaks. You will NOT be able to do the homework by yourself. The TA's are a godsend and will walk you through the entire homework. This is likely the worst class you will take. But its not impossi
Is this class easy? no
Is the homework useful? no
But, is he willing to help? also no

it is incredibly difficult succeed in this class without the help of the TA's (angels). if you have to take this class, go to office hours every week to get your homework checked. lectures are tough to understand, was a 8am, and mjelde is not approachable. this class is excel heavy. one midterm and final that are tough. avoid if at all possible.
this guy sux

RMP won't let me say what I put in my course eval. This professor does not like students. He enjoys failing students and will treat you poorly if you try and receive help. Can't understand lectures, canvas is disorganized, and homework doesn't relate to material. All of this would be fine if he wasn't teaching the hardest course in the department.

NEVER TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! I dedicated all my time to hu class for a D? For exams, I assisted study sessions, took notes and looked back at quizzes and homeworks but nothing helped. Never missed any labs, assignments, and even had to miss lectures for other courses to work on his long homework assignments. The material was very hard! This was hell!

Do not recommend this professor at all! This class was a mess! First of all, you could not understand anything during lecture. Second, his lectures, hw and quizzes did not correlate with his exams. Third, his exams are extremely difficult!!! His homeworks took a lot of time and were extremely long! It all came up to who guessed better at exams.

Every review here is true. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. He is the worst teacher I have had in my lifetime, and I cannot stress how terrible this course was. Nothing about the class was clear, extremely rude and belittling with almost every question you ask him. I hope he gets a replacement soon so no one else has to take this course from him.

l never thought I would take a class that took so much of my time that it affects other classes. Mjelde asks for so much work when he doesnt even explain any of it. TAs are helpful. The university/department should be ashamed that they have him as a professor. I still have no idea what use this class is teaching and I feel cheated out of my tuition

This man has no respect for his students or staff, and clearly hates his job.  The exams are worth more than 50% of the final grade, and they do not cover any material discussed in lab or lecture.  Homeworks take forever and are made to ruin your life.  I wish I could attach my course evaluation, but it does not follow RMP guidelines.

His class was bad all around. Nothing ever made sense. The only reason I may pass this class is due to the TAs help on labs and homeworks. James is not helpful; he is sarcastic and rude to every student.  He is in the top 3 of worst professors I have had at TAMU.  Avoid taking him if possible, and please recognize all of his reviews are truthful.

The worst professor I have taken at TAMU. Clearly has no appreciation for his students or TA's. He comes to class just to pick on students for asking questions. Absolutely nothing we learn in lecture pertains to the homework's. Exams included as much jargon as possible. None of the reviews on this page are overexaggerating. Embarrassing.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I made an account just to give him a review. Avoid at all costs. I have no idea how this man is allowed to teach at a University when he CLEARLY hates students. Condescending, rude, and has had two TA's quit. I try so hard, and have no idea what is going on. Embarrassing to have a professor like him at a University like TAMU.

Terrible, everything is different. Exams, quizzes, homework, and lectures, are all different. Very disrespectful to students, and WILL NOT help with any question you ask. Need help? Raise your hand, ask your question and he will say "You tell me." You may not have a choice to take someone else, if so, good luck, you'll need it.

By far the worst class and instructor I've had at A&M. Very unorganized and he does not help you... the TAs do. The lectures are nothing like the HWs. The exams are on paper even though it is an excel heavy class. Highly recommend going to the TAs with questions.

Avoid if possible. He seems like a good guy outside of class, but he is just a horrible professor. He expects you to know everything without even teaching the material. Weekly homeworks are close to impossible and make absolutely no sense. The structure of this class is so unorganized and I still am not sure what the purpose of this class was.
He is a hard professor. Nevertheless, I managed to get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The worst professor I took at TAMU! First class I ever made a D in!! Class consisted of 5 HWs, 10 quizzes, a midterm test, and a final. Material he taught in class was completely different than on the tests, HW, and quizzes. He did give extra credit if you went to class though and curves big on the tests.

This was easily in the top 3 hardest classes I took at A&M over the course of 4 years. The only way to be successful in this class is to attend lectures. There were two tests that largely determined your grade. The amount of information required for these tests was astronomical. Be prepared to work very hard if you want an A or B.

For anyone that is thinking about taking this class I would think twice. Never had a issue with a prof at TAMU, except this one. The of the most inconsiderate, unapologetic, and myogenetic teacher I have had. On top of that, the test have "trick questions" and have no correlation to the material taught in class.

AVOID AT ALL COST! I'm pretty sure this class is not passable. His tests are all trick questions, misspelled, and don't cover the material given. I made a 47 on the first test and later realized the class average was a 50 (which he did not curve). My advisor informed me that so many people are failing, she is filing a complaint with his department.

Lectures and assignments and exams full of jargon. 
Despite best efforts, difficult to understand how professor mjelde writes his exams. They read like a long winding novel written in 1650.
His eagerness to lecture is hard not to interpret as abrasive and mild-medium misogynistic.

I gotta chime in here because contrary to previous reviews, he's not THAT bad. Yes- his lectures are kind of boring, but he knows what he's talking about and his material isn't that hard- it's just not super clear cut. Good at teaching? Not necessarily, but a bad teacher? No.

Really should have looked at ratings prior to taking. Wildly inconsistent communication about grading with his TAs, argues about the correct answers. Absolute scavenger hunt for information that should be readily available or learned with the class, don’t know how to answer quiz/exam questions with information taught in class/read in textbook.

Mjelde is a horrible professor. His homework assignments are graded by a TA who is inaccessible outside of class and he refuses to give feedback on homework grading. He is the sole grader of tests and does so with bewildering inconsistency. His test material is not congruent with his homeworks or lectures. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.

Does not know how to teach effectively! Quizzes, homework, and tests are worded tricky and hard. Have never struggled this bad in a class! TAs have been helpful! Sees students struggling and could care less to change his methods of teaching. Overall horrible class and professor. DO NOT TAKE!!
Dr. Mjelde is a good professor. Hard material. but easier than some of the other professors for 105. If you go into his office and ask for help, he is very helpful. Tests are difficult.
Do not take this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I HAVE NEVER HAD A TEACH LIKE HIM, HE EXPECTS YOU TO KNOW EVERYTHING ALREADY. EXTREMELY DIFFUCULT. DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mjelde does not teach the class at all. A graduate student does. Luckily I had a great one (Dinhobl) but I have heard that others are not as great. Easy class if you show up, at least with my GA. Lots of easy in-class quizzes and HW was graded on completion most of the time. Tests weren't too easy but he always curved.
Professor doesnt even teach, has PHD Students teach instead. Luckily I got put with the good one, heard the other PHD student barely speaks english so no one knows whats going on

Beware if you take him. I took him spring of 2021 online and it was a battle. All his lectures were pre-recorded and his lecturing style was very boring and EXTREMELY difficult to understand. He gave us weekly homework, quizzes, 3 test, and a final. Do this class somewhere else whether it's Blinn or a different prof at TAMU. Good luck...
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst prof I have ever had at Texas A&M. He is SO rude and makes it very clear that he does not give a crap about his students. Very rude in emails, refuses to give back credit even if it is HIS mistake. Tests and quizzes are totally different than the homework. I put hours into this class to do the lectures and the homework and I am scraping by.

Be prepared for an uphill battle with this professor. Other students and I have had to teach the material to ourselves because Dr. Mjelde does not lecture effectively. The questions on the quizzes and test are worded oddly, and there are very few examples on how to complete the homework. If possible, I would take another professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Don't. Take. This. Prof. Low key rude and does not seem to care about his students at ALL. Unhelpful, does not seem like he wants you to succeed in his own class. Quizzes and tests are so confusing and way too difficult for an intro course. The TAs were nice, but that's about the only good thing about this class Just take a different professor man

Horrible professor. His lectures are extremely boring and he expects you to already know the material. Gives long homework assignments and tests are very difficult. I highly suggest taking another professor.

His teaching style is somewhat expecting you to know it so he doesn't teach in a way for you to learn, more you have to assume what is correct. He is very confusing and I can't tell you I learned much from this class. The only reason I took him is there was supposed to be a good prof but he ended up needing surgery so was replaced by Mjelde.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: It's supposed to be an INTRO class, but it most definitely is not taught, tested, or graded that way. His AGEC class was my 4th time taking an Economics class and the ONLY one I didn't make an A in. He's very condensending and sarcastic in class, but very approachable during office hours. Go to class, go to the SI and go see him. Good luck!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Take a different prof

Mjelde is the kind of professor who gets bored teaching his own class, and fails to explain anything. Homework is very important, tests are extremely hard, questions and answers are designed to trick and mislead you. The best part of his class is that you can drop your lowest test grade, because quite frankly, you're gonna need to.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Contrary to previous reviews, Professor Mjelde is a good professor, but he doesn't have the time to cover information in-depth during lecture. Homework is very important to the grade, and tests are very difficult. If you are struggling, take advantage of the TA's and Mjelde's office hours. He is an excellent professor 1 on 1. Study previous tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Doesn't know how to teach AT ALL

I have taken Econ. courses for three years now, and this one has by far been the toughest. He doesn't explain concepts well at all, and doesn't help very much when you ask for it. Questions on homeworks and exams are also worded weird, making them very hard to understand what he's even asking.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Mjelde is easily the worst professor I have ever had, and I've had some bad ones. His lectures are long and boring, you will literally can not get out of his class fast enough. Not to mention he is extremely disrespectful to students and if you ask a question he either acts like your dumb, or doesn't acknowledge you at all. DONT TAKE HIM!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Came in as a replacement to the prof our class was supposed to have. Tests are hard. Uses lots of iClicker questions in class, and they are worth a big percent of your grade. Lectures are boring and hard to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Definitely not the easiest course I've taken. His lectures seem long and are boring, but you must pay attention to them. He gives lots of iclicker points based on them. Lots of homework. GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS BEFORE AN EXAM!!! Tests are pretty difficult. He is actually very helpful if you go in during office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I went up and asked him a question on the homework, and him and the TA stood there laughing at me in front of other students and I didn't even get my question answered.  It made me so embarrassed that I honestly didn't want to ask them for help again.  I wouldn't take him.

Expect HW weekly. He gives quite a bit of extra credit. There are 3 test in which he drops the lowest test grade. Also, going to lecture is a good idea because he does a lot of clicker questions. As long as you go to class, do the homework, and extra credit there is no way you could fail.
Tough class, but if you show up to class and do your work you should be fine. Lectures are not very interesting, but does a lot of clicker questions during lecture so it is important to go.

You can fail every test and still pass. Don't get me wrong,  you still have to work for your grade. He drops the lowest test score, gives tons of extra credit, and there are many opportunities to improve your grade. I actually learned in this class!  He is a great professor. Take his class!

James Mjelde is an OK professor. He doesn't wear a mic in class so be sure to sit in the front to hear him. He posts old tests online so be sure to study those as they are helpful. MAKE SURE that you purchase an iclicker before the first day and bring it to class every time. Clicker points and extra credit will save you. Go to class every time!
It's a fairly easy course if you actually come to class and prepare for the tests. Don't procrastinate too much and you'll do fine.
